extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants and practitioners (attorneys/agents) filing an AFCP 2.0 request in response to a final rejection
extracted.subtask_description: Completing and submitting the USPTO certification and request form to invoke the After Final Consideration Pilot Program 2.0 (AFCP 2.0) when filing a response after a final rejection under 37 CFR 1.116. The form documents eligibility, required contents of the response, procedural commitments (e.g., interview availability), and compliance with filing and signature rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application type eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: The above-identified application is (i) an original utility, plant, or design nonprovisional application filed under 35 U.S.C. 111(a) [a continuing application (e.g., a continuation or divisional application) is filed under 35 U.S.C. 111(a) and is eligible under (i)], or (ii) an international application that has entered the national stage in compliance with 35 U.S.C. 371(c).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This criterion defines which application types may participate in AFCP 2.0; continuing applications filed under 35 U.S.C. 111(a) are explicitly included; reissue and reexamination are separately excluded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outstanding final rejection
rubrics_metrics.description: The above-identified application contains an outstanding final rejection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The AFCP 2.0 request must be in response to a currently outstanding final rejection in the application file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Response under 37 CFR 1.116 is submitted
rubrics_metrics.description: Submitted herewith is a response under 37 CFR 1.116 to the outstanding final rejection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The submission invoking AFCP 2.0 must be an actual 37 CFR 1.116 response (i.e., a response after final rejection); the AFCP certification accompanies that response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment to at least one independent claim
rubrics_metrics.description: The response includes an amendment to at least one independent claim.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An amendment to at least one independent claim is required for AFCP 2.0 consideration; dependent-claim-only amendments would not satisfy this criterion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment does not broaden independent claim
rubrics_metrics.description: The amendment does not broaden the scope of the independent claim in any aspect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The amendment must be narrowing or at least not broaden the independent claim(s); broadening amendments are disallowed under this program request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single AFCP 2.0 certification per final rejection
rubrics_metrics.description: This certification and request for consideration under AFCP 2.0 is the only AFCP 2.0 certification and request filed in response to the outstanding final rejection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only one AFCP 2.0 certification/request may be filed in response to a given outstanding final rejection; duplicate requests for the same rejection are not permitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant interview availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant is willing and available to participate in any interview requested by the examiner concerning the present response.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requesting AFCP 2.0 implies applicant's willingness/availability to attend examiner-requested interviews; interview scheduling and responses affect how the examiner proceeds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic filing requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: This certification and request is being filed electronically using the USPTO's patent electronic filing system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: AFCP 2.0 requests must be submitted via the USPTO electronic filing system; this affirms compliance with the USPTO's electronic submission expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concurrent payment of any applicable fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Any fees that would be necessary consistent with current practice concerning responses after final rejection under 37 CFR 1.116, e.g., extension of time fees, are being concurrently filed herewith. [There is no additional fee required to request consideration under AFCP 2.0.]
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While AFCP 2.0 itself has no additional fee, any fees normally required for the underlying 1.116 response (such as extension fees) must be paid concurrently; failure to include required fees may affect processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ineligible proceedings (reissue/reexamination)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reissue applications and reexamination proceedings are not eligible to participate in AFCP 2.0.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This exclusion clarifies scope: only the application types in the eligibility criterion may participate; reissue and reexamination are explicitly barred.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiner verification of AFCP compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: The examiner will verify that the AFCP 2.0 submission is compliant, i.e., that the requirements of the program have been met (see items 1 to 7 above).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The USPTO examiner will check the submission against the listed eligibility and content criteria; compliance is a precondition to AFCP processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiner determination of need for additional search/consideration and time feasibility
rubrics_metrics.description: The examiner will review the response under 37 CFR 1.116 to determine if additional search and/or consideration (i) is necessitated by the amendment and (ii) could be completed within the time allotted under AFCP 2.0.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Two-step assessment: necessity of further search/consideration due to the amendment, and whether that additional work can be completed within the program's time window. If additional work is required but cannot be completed in time, the examiner will revert to standard processing (e.g., advisory action).

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiner consideration of allowance after additional search/consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: If the examiner determines that the amendment does not necessitate additional search and/or consideration, or if the examiner determines that additional search and/or consideration is required and could be completed within the allotted time, then the examiner will consider whether the amendment places the application in condition for allowance (after completing the additional search and/or consideration, if required).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If no further work is needed or it can be done in time, the examiner will decide whether the amendment results in a condition for allowance; processing depends on that determination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiner contact and interview if not in condition for allowance
rubrics_metrics.description: If the examiner determines that the amendment does not place the application in condition for allowance, then the examiner will contact the applicant and request an interview.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: AFCP 2.0 contemplates examiner-initiated interviews to resolve remaining issues if the amendment alone does not result in allowance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interview conduct and scheduling constraints
rubrics_metrics.description: The interview will be conducted by the examiner, and if the examiner does not have negotiation authority, a primary examiner and/or supervisory patent examiner will also participate. If the applicant declines the interview, or if the interview cannot be scheduled within ten (10) calendar days from the date that the examiner first contacts the applicant, then the examiner will proceed consistent with current practice concerning responses after final rejection under 37 CFR 1.116.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interviews are expected to be timely; participation by higher-level examiners may occur if needed. Declining or failing to schedule within 10 days results in normal (non-AFCP) processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Signature and certification compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: This form must be signed in accordance with 37 CFR 1.33. See 37 CFR 1.4(d) for signature requirements and certifications. Submit multiple forms if more than one signature is required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proper signing and certification are mandatory; multiple signatories require separate forms. Failure to sign correctly may render the request defective.
